It loads the aggregate through a repository, delegates the business behaviour to the domain with order.deliver(), and checks the aggregate's validity. It then persists the order and publishes domain events through the EventPublisher. This is coordination, which fits the application layer. It holds no business rules of its own and no persistence or transport details such as SQL, HTTP handling or serialization. Throwing NotFoundException is a borderline framework-flavoured choice, but it is not a different layer's responsibility. The import of the infrastructure repository is a dependency-direction matter and is out of scope.
